name: LastPass
summary: LastPass sells Teams for up to 50 users, Business at $7 per user a month and Business Max at $11, all billed annually. Business allows single sign-on to three apps, and unlimited apps need Business Max.

facts.text: LastPass disclosed in 2022 that an attacker copied a backup of customer vault data from cloud storage, and it updated the notice through December 22, 2022.
LastPass states that it encrypts vaults with AES-256 and PBKDF2 SHA-256 under a zero-knowledge model, and it runs a bug bounty program.
LastPass lists HIPAA among the regulations it says it complies with.
Monitoring of AI tools, SaaS apps and web traffic is included only with Business Max.
LastPass can store passkeys in the vault, and the vault still opens with the master password.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: Billed annually at $51 per user. Up to 50 users.

hiddenCosts: Business includes single sign-on for three apps only; unlimited apps need Business Max.
Teams has no single sign-on or directory integration and stops at 50 users.
The business terms allow extra fees when the number of users goes above the purchased quantity.

contract.cancellation: Renews for 12 months unless notice is given at least 30 days before the term ends; payments are non-refundable except in limited cases the terms list.
contract.dataExport: After termination, customers get limited access for up to 30 days to retrieve or delete their data.
